subject: Civil Engineering
title: Response Spectrum: Design Tool
description: A short lesson to help you apply Response Spectrum: Design Tool.

hook.text: How hard will an earthquake shake a building? The response spectrum provides the answer.

buildup.text: It plots peak acceleration against natural period — a different answer for every building.

discovery.text: Short-period buildings (stiff) feel higher acceleration. Long-period buildings sway more.

twist.text: Design spectra smooth out real earthquake data into a standard curve for code design.

climax.text: Engineers read the spectrum to find the seismic force their building must resist.

punchline.text: One chart tells every building how hard it will be shaken. That's the spectrum.

quiz.question: What does a response spectrum plot?
options: Peak acceleration versus natural period for different structures
Earthquake magnitude versus distance from the epicenter
